item.title: August 05, 2026 - The shape of our thoughts
item.description: Page 227. "By shaping our thoughts with spiritual ideals, we are freed to become who we want to be." Just for Today: I will allow spiritual ideals to shape my thoughts. In that design, I will find the shape of my own Higher Power.
